annotations.title: Web page or PDF to Markdown

description: Web page, PDF or text file to clean Markdown: main content kept (headings, lists, links, tables, code), navigation and ads removed, links made absolute; PDFs as text with page count. JavaScript-only pages are refused, not charged. Honours robots.txt, refuses private addresses; limits 2 MB HTML, 8 MB PDF, 15 s; output capped at 200,000 characters (marked truncated). Nothing is stored. Read-only. Free for MCP clients up to 3 reports per client per day; beyond the quota the response lists the paid access options (x402 on the HTTP route, or a prepaid credit key) instead of a report. Never pays or signs anything itself. Automated conversion; the content belongs to its publisher and may be incomplete.
